title: Cold rebuild: bounded and structured in Python
summary: fetch_all with a Semaphore and a TaskGroup again, from memory, on the real machine.

steps.title: From memory
body: Write `fetch_all` again from *asyncio: TaskGroup, Semaphore and the GIL*. The machine starts fresh with the sequential version;
no hints and no solution this time. The checks are the same.

steps.prompt: Warm-up: in a `TaskGroup`, one task raises `ValueError`. What does the `async with` block do?
options: Cancels the other tasks, waits for them, then raises an ExceptionGroup containing the ValueError
Raises the ValueError at once and leaves the others running
Ignores it and returns the other results
steps.explain: That is structured concurrency: nothing outlives the block, and every failure is reported.

steps.title: Rebuild fetch_all cold
prompt: Make `fetch_all(skus, get_price, limit)` in `~/prices/fetch.py` run the calls concurrently with at most `limit` at once, using
`asyncio.TaskGroup` so that a failure cancels the rest. It returns `{sku: price}`.
